description: TRANSEARCH is a proprietary US freight flow database, now sold by S&P Global and earlier by IHS Markit, that states often buy for freight planning. Contents, as described in a 2016 Florida DOT comparison with the Freight Analysis Framework: commodity flows by origin, destination, commodity and mode, built from county-level production and consumption estimates, with rail, water and air flows, truck flows including specialised truck movements, imports and exports, apportionment to traffic analysis zones and long-range forecasts. Coverage: the United States at county level with cross-border flows; Florida bought a 2011 edition tailored to the state. Format and access: delivered to licensees; formats were not read. Licence and cost: paid, under licence. Caveats: the vendor page refused the cloud session, so details come from a user's review; methods are partly undisclosed and some flows are not covered. Used for network flow and capacity planning in state freight models and corridor studies. It relates to the Freight Analysis Framework in the catalogue, the free alternative it is often compared with.
